notes: Validated against Serganov et al. Cell 2004 (doi:10.1016/j.cell.2004.11.020). Guanine (GUN X:101) binds via Watson-Crick face to U74: N1-H donates to U74 O2, O6 accepts from U74 N3-H. N2-H contacts A52. Stacking: U47 above, A23 below (same sandwich geometry as 1Y26 adenine riboswitch). The single-residue difference C74→U74 (vs 1Y26) switches adenine/guanine selectivity. GDP (X:14) and CCC (X:81) removed as crystallization artifacts. No Mg ions present in structure.
